description: This header file defines classes and functions for buffered console output stream and logging utilities, including class declarations, method prototypes, and macro definitions related to the logging system.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Defines a buffered console output stream with methods for appending text, formatting, and managing the buffer.

classes.name: LoggingWithStorage
classes.description: Extends Logging class by adding a default buffer, facilitating logging with external storage.

methods.name: baseConstructor
methods.description: Initializes the Logging object, intended as a base constructor setup.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Default constructor for the Logging class.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Constructor that initializes logging with a name, buffer, and buffer size.

methods.name: initLoggingExt
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the logging with external buffer settings.

methods.name: vappendPrintf
methods.description: Appends formatted data to the logging buffer using va_list.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: appendFast
methods.description: Fast append operation for a string.

methods.name: appendPrintf
methods.description: Appends formatted text to the buffer.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if a Logging object has been initialized.

methods.name: resetLogging
methods.description: Resets the logging buffer.

methods.name: appendMsgPrefix
methods.description: Prepends a message prefix to the log.

methods.name: appendMsgPostfix
methods.description: Appends a message postfix to the log.

methods.name: remainingSize
methods.description: Returns the remaining size of the buffer.

methods.name: loggingSize
methods.description: Calculates the current size of the logged message.

methods.name: printMsg
methods.description: Prints a formatted message.

methods.name: appendPrintf
methods.description: Appends formatted data with variable arguments.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends text to logging buffer.

methods.name: appendFast
methods.description: Performs a quick append of text.

methods.name: scheduleLogging
methods.description: Schedules the current log buffer for output.

methods.name: printPending
methods.description: Outputs all pending logs.

methods.name: printWithLength
methods.description: Prints a line of a specified length.
